salons.salons_public_read.using: ((is_active AND profile_completed AND (approval_status = 'approved'::salon_approval_status)) OR (owner_id = auth.uid()) OR is_super_admin())

staff.staff_approval_read.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM salons sl
  WHERE ((sl.id = staff.salon_id) AND ((sl.is_active AND sl.profile_completed AND (sl.approval_status = 'approved'::salon_approval_status)) OR (sl.owner_id = auth.uid()) OR is_super_admin()))))

salons.salons_owner_update.check:
((owner_id = auth.uid()) AND (is_active = ( SELECT s.is_active
   FROM salons s
  WHERE (s.id = salons.id))))

bookings.bookings_staff_read.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM staff access_staff
  WHERE ((access_staff.salon_id = bookings.salon_id) AND (access_staff.profile_id = auth.uid()) AND access_staff.is_active)))

services.services_approval_read.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM salons sl
  WHERE ((sl.id = services.salon_id) AND ((sl.is_active AND sl.profile_completed AND (sl.approval_status = 'approved'::salon_approval_status)) OR (sl.owner_id = auth.uid()) OR is_super_admin()))))

blocked_slots.blocked_owner_write.check:
(((staff_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM staff s
  WHERE ((s.id = blocked_slots.staff_id) AND owns_salon(s.salon_id))))) OR ((salon_id IS NOT NULL) AND owns_salon(salon_id)))
blocked_slots.blocked_owner_write.using:
(((staff_id IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM staff s
  WHERE ((s.id = blocked_slots.staff_id) AND owns_salon(s.salon_id))))) OR ((salon_id IS NOT NULL) AND owns_salon(salon_id)))

booking_services.booking_services_read.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM bookings b
  WHERE ((b.id = booking_services.booking_id) AND ((b.customer_id = auth.uid()) OR owns_salon(b.salon_id) OR is_super_admin()))))
